fills.researcher_notes: Same corridor and same dead end as P4135 (Faisalabad-Shahdara Gas Pipeline-I), which this line runs alongside/duplicates by name. Search results for 'Faisalabad-Shahdara' + SNGPL/pipeline surface only the two gem.wiki pages (Pipeline-I and Pipeline-II) and generic SNGPL billing-service pages -- no independent article, annual report, or licence document names either line. No SNGPL/OGRA engineering-document class found that would date this segment (OGRA site 403s automated fetch; SNGPL's own history/about pages don't go below network-wide totals). Leaving StartYear1 blank rather than assuming a shared date with Pipeline-I without evidence for either.

validity.recommendation: No action on Diameter/LengthKnown -- both are corroborated exactly against SNGPL's own asset register, which also explains why this row's Diameter is multi-valued (16, 24). Date_logic remains genuinely unresolved.
validity.researcher_notes: LOUD FLAG (same finding on every row in this brief): SNGPL Annual Report 2018, pages 32-35 ('TRANSMISSION SYSTEM As at June 30, 2018', https://www.sngpl.com.pk/download/AnnualReport-2018/SNGPLAR-2018.pdf) is a text-searchable per-segment register of the whole network. Row 113 'FSD - SHAHDARA / 16in / mainline 57.48 km / loopline 119.25 km' + row 115 'FSD - SHAHDARA / 24in / loopline 55.03 km': 57.48 + 55.03 = 112.51 km -- an EXACT match to this row's LengthKnown, and the two diameters (16, 24) exactly match this row's multi-value Diameter field. This row is therefore a composite of the corridor's original 16in mainline plus a separate later 24in loopline (P4135, by contrast, is purely the 16in loopline of the same corridor) -- a genuine granularity artifact, not an error, per the protocol's guidance on length_ratio-style composites. The register has no dates, so it cannot resolve StartYear1, but it does mean a single StartYear1 for this row would be describing two physically-distinct-vintage assets if one is ever sourced.
